term: fixed strict-genus taxonomy in the q3a4 cause comparison
definition: The concrete Term carrier has genus, species, differentia and being predicables. Both Bool bearers are in the designated genus; genus and differentia are essentially said of their represented species, while genus is not essentially said of its own differentia. Existing q3a4 Profile fields represent actuality, essence, esse and efficient cause. SameNoncausalData is equality of every Profile field except CausesIn. These are explicit finite interpretations, not real genus/differentia constituents or a definition of metaphysical dependence.
note: A task-local joint countermodel arena using existing predication and q3a4 interfaces. Its source-application and real-composition bridge are deliberately open; see docs/notes/composition-causal-scope.md.
